bg.title: Оценка на отговорното управление на AI
bg.intro: 25 въпроса в 12 области: от опис и класификация на данните до prompt injection, човешки контрол, проследимост, промени и срокове. Резултатът е анализ на пропуските, приоритизиран списък за поправка и примерни документи.
bg.disclaimer: Образователна самооценка по вашите отговори. Не е правен съвет, не е правен одит и не удостоверява съответствие с AI Act, GDPR или друг закон. Не се свързваме с вашите системи.

rec_injection.description: Отделяне на данните от инструкциите, проверка на изхода и ограничени инструменти.

rec_oversight.description: Нива на риск с писмени правила кога одобрява човек.

rec_evaluation.description: Тестови набори с критерии за пускане и наблюдение в работа.

rec_traceability.description: Журнал на входа, източниците и версиите, със защита на личните данни.

rec_incidents.title: Реакция при инциденти с AI
rec_incidents.description: Процес за докладване, бързо изключване и упражнения.

pattern_governance_documents.title: Примерни документи за управление (шаблони, не правни документи)
pattern_governance_documents.description: Политика за използване на AI; регистър на AI системите; шаблон за оценка на риска и въздействието; описание на системата (system card); наръчник при инцидент с AI; въпросник за доставчици. Адаптирайте ги към вашата организация с юрист.

pattern_review_workflow.title: Примерен процес за преглед и одобрение
pattern_review_workflow.description: Заявка за нов AI случай → класификация на риска → преглед (сигурност, поверителност, бизнес отговорник) → одобрение с условия → наблюдение и периодичен преглед → спиране, когато вече не е нужен.

ts_governance_board.title: Редовен преглед на AI портфолиото
ts_governance_board.description: Тримесечен преглед на системите, рисковете и инцидентите с бизнеса, сигурността и юрист.

ctx_ai_act.title: Може да попадате в по-строги изисквания
ctx_ai_act.description: Решения за хора и AI в продукти могат да попаднат в категории с повече задължения. Тази оценка не определя задълженията ви и не удостоверява съответствие; за това е нужен юрист.

en.title: Responsible AI Governance Assessment
en.intro: 25 questions across 12 areas: from inventory and data classification to prompt injection, human oversight, traceability, change and retention. The result is a gap analysis, a prioritised remediation checklist and example documents.
en.disclaimer: An educational self-assessment based on your answers. Not legal advice, not a legal audit, and it does not confirm compliance with the AI Act, GDPR or any other law. We do not connect to your systems.

initial.title: Initial
initial.description: Most practices are manual or missing; risk depends on individual people.

developing.title: Developing
developing.description: Basic practices exist, but not everywhere and not consistently.

defined.title: Defined
defined.description: Practices are standardised and most are applied automatically.

optimised.title: Optimised
optimised.description: Practices are automated, measured and continuously improved.

risk_shadow_ai.title: Uncontrolled use of AI
risk_shadow_ai.description: Without an inventory you do not know what data leaves and where.

risk_personal_data.title: Personal data without rules
risk_personal_data.description: Personal data sent to AI without rules or an agreement is a privacy risk.

risk_exfiltration.title: Possible data exfiltration
risk_exfiltration.description: AI that can send data out without approval is the main exfiltration path for prompt injection.

risk_decisions_without_oversight.title: Decisions about people without oversight
risk_decisions_without_oversight.description: AI that influences decisions about people without human approval is a high-risk case.

risk_live_changes.title: Changes straight into production
risk_live_changes.description: Changing a model or prompt without review can silently change behaviour.

qw_inventory.title: An AI system register
qw_inventory.description: A table: system → purpose → data → vendor → owner.

qw_data_rules.title: A rule for data sent to AI
qw_data_rules.description: One page: which data is never entered into AI tools.

qw_approval_boundaries.title: Written AI boundaries
qw_approval_boundaries.description: A list of actions that always require human approval.

qw_report_channel.title: A channel to report problems
qw_report_channel.description: A button or form to report a wrong or harmful answer.

qw_retention.title: A retention period for logs
qw_retention.description: Set and enforce a period for prompts and answers; disable unnecessary vendor retention.

rec_inventory.title: Inventory and accountability
rec_inventory.description: A register of AI systems with an owner for each.

rec_classification.title: Data classes for AI
rec_classification.description: Classification applied to AI tools too, with technical restrictions.

rec_vendors.title: Vendor assessment
rec_vendors.description: A security questionnaire and a processing agreement with every vendor.

rec_privacy.title: Privacy for AI
rec_privacy.description: Personal data minimisation and impact assessments for sensitive cases.

rec_threat_modeling.title: Threat modelling
rec_threat_modeling.description: A review before launch and on change, including AI-specific threats.

rec_injection.title: Prompt-injection controls
rec_injection.description: Separate data from instructions, check outputs and limit tools.

rec_oversight.title: Approval boundaries
rec_oversight.description: Risk levels with written rules for when a person approves.

rec_evaluation.title: Quality evaluation
rec_evaluation.description: Test sets with release criteria and production monitoring.

rec_traceability.title: Traceability
rec_traceability.description: A log of inputs, sources and versions, with personal data protected.

rec_incidents.title: AI incident response
rec_incidents.description: A reporting process, a quick switch-off and exercises.

rec_change.title: Change management
rec_change.description: Review, test, approval and rollback when changing a model or prompt.

rec_retention.title: Retention and deletion
rec_retention.description: Periods for all logs and minimal retention at vendors.

pattern_governance_documents.title: Example governance documents (templates, not legal documents)
pattern_governance_documents.description: An AI use policy; an AI system register; a risk and impact assessment template; a system card; an AI incident playbook; a vendor questionnaire. Adapt them to your organisation with a lawyer.

pattern_review_workflow.title: Suggested review and approval workflow
pattern_review_workflow.description: A request for a new AI use case → risk classification → review (security, privacy, business owner) → approval with conditions → monitoring and periodic re-review → retirement when no longer needed.

ts_governance_board.title: A regular AI portfolio review
ts_governance_board.description: A quarterly review of systems, risks and incidents with the business, security and a lawyer.

ctx_ai_act.title: You may fall under stricter requirements
ctx_ai_act.description: Decisions about people and AI in products can fall into categories with more obligations. This assessment does not determine your obligations or confirm compliance; a lawyer does.
